thread:
maria_g: Hey team — planning next Wed RFC review block (10–11am PT). Need to slot authors and confirm reviewers + pre-reads. Proposed list:
1) model-caching — @devin
2) kv-cache-eviction — @sasha
3) rollout-sharding — @kevin
Can reviewers ping availability and any swap requests? Please mark pre-reads done with :eyes:. Drafts: https://docs.internal/rfcs/next-review

devin: I can review model-caching, prefer earlier slot (10:00). Will add comments by EOD Mon. :thumbsup:

sasha: I'm the author for kv-cache-eviction — heads up I have an infra stand overlap at 10:20. Can someone swap with me? Otherwise I can move to 10:40 but it'll be tight.

kevin: I can swap — I don't mind taking 10:20 but I have a customer call at 10:45. Suggest ordering: model-caching, rollout-sharding, kv-cache-eviction so my bit ends earlier.

eva: Quick note — skimmed model-caching and left inline comments. I can pick up kv-cache review if sasha needs time.

deploy-bot: Reminder: add 'pre-read done' reaction in this thread to trigger the review reminders report. Scheduled reminder for Mon 09:00 PT.

maria_g: OK thanks — swapping seems fine. Proposed final order (per kevin) — putting it here so calendar invites match:
```
Wed 10:00 - model-caching (devin reviewer)
Wed 10:20 - rollout-sharding (kevin reviewer)
Wed 10:40 - kv-cache-eviction (sasha author)
```
@sasha can you confirm 10:40 works if we move you? If not we keep original and @kevin will cover first half of his section. Also please attach 1 slide summary + key questions to each RFC doc by Tue EOD.

devin: :thumbsup: 10:00 works for me.

sasha: 10:40 is fine, I can trim slides. I'll tag when pre-read done.

kevin: I'll prepare the rollout slides and a 3-minute rollback summary.

maria_g: Great — I'll update the calendar and set the invite order. Final ask: reviewers, drop a quick line with any blocking topics (security, perf, infra) so we can allocate extra time ahead of the meeting. :eyes:

eva: Noted, I'll flag perf numbers if anything looks off after my second pass.

maria_g: Thanks all — calendared and invites sent. Reminder: pre-reads/report triggers Mon 09:00.
